# Fuserwise & GrowthBook | Introduction Call
Date: 2026-10-27 | Duration: 34.779998779296875m

## Summary
Fuserwise, a Hungary-based provider of QA and UX testing for European startups and scale-ups, evaluated GrowthBook for its internal operations platform. The platform is being developed to organize testing workflows, track sessions, and manage features, with a possible future customer-facing UX product. An MVP feature flag has been integrated successfully as a simple on-off control, although platform navigation and unfamiliar feature areas require further exploration. GrowthBook connects feature flags with experiments, product analytics, metric dashboards, AI-generated experiment learnings, and guardrails that can automatically deactivate features after negative results. Its technical model supports existing data warehouses, web and mobile SDKs, user attributes, cloud or self-hosted deployment, European Union cloud availability, and analytical processing without PII. Internal use is the current priority; partner deployment and subscription scaling were discussed only as future possibilities. Benedek will continue independent testing, while a deeper technical session and platform materials remain available.

## Keywords
Feature flags, Experimentation, Product analytics, Warehouse-native architecture, UX testing, Fuserwise internal platform
